INFJ>INTJ.title: You write "Who will this help?" right into the blueprint.
INFJ>INTJ.body: When you make a plan, you put "Will this work?" and "Who will this help?" side by side on the same desk. Thinking deeply on your own and working backward from where things are headed is solid ground for you, by nature and by experience. You move easily between sensing how people feel and building things step by step, so people quietly come to rely on you.
INFJ>INTJ.say: "The logic holds. Now it's just how they'll take it."
INFJ>INTJ.do: The night before a meeting, you fill a notebook with answers to every likely objection—and gentle ways to say them.
INFJ>INTJ.worry: You can see the right answer, but choosing your words takes so long that you speak up late. On days you pick efficiency, the faces of the people you left behind stay with you all night.
INFJ>INTJ.karai: You've planned five years ahead, but you still haven't replied about tomorrow's dinner.

INFJ>INTP.title: A caring heart with a "but why?" that never stops.
INFJ>INTP.body: When a friend comes to you with a problem, you take in their feelings—and somehow end up taking the whole problem apart, too. Going deep in your alone time and hunting for meaning you can't see is something that's always been yours. Warm empathy and a curiosity that digs with logic, steady planning and the freedom to rethink on the spot: you reach for whichever the moment needs.
INFJ>INTP.say: "That sounds so hard. …Wait, but why did it happen that way?"
INFJ>INTP.do: You start one quick search before bed, and three hours later you're reading a research paper from a totally different field.
INFJ>INTP.worry: You want to help, but the thinking gets so fun that your hands stop moving. Right after you make a plan, a better way pops into your head and you want to start over.
INFJ>INTP.karai: You can explain your life's purpose, but the laundry is still sitting in the dryer.

INFJ>ENTJ.title: Quiet insight, turned into the force that moves a team.
INFJ>ENTJ.body: You say "Friday is the deadline, final," and then walk straight over to check on the person who looks tired. Seeing ahead and turning decisions into results is the part of you that never wavers. Deep thinking on your own and stepping up to lead, deciding with heart and deciding with logic—you can use all of them as your own.
INFJ>ENTJ.say: "Okay, Friday it is. By the way, Sam, are you getting any sleep?"
INFJ>ENTJ.do: You put the team's goals on one sheet, then fill the margins with what each person is best at.
INFJ>ENTJ.worry: The more you take charge, the less time you have to think alone. When you need to be firm, the other person's face comes to mind, and some nights you blame yourself afterward.
INFJ>ENTJ.karai: You make sure everyone gets their days off, but your own break is always "sometime."

INFJ>ENTP.title: You fire up the debate, then quietly help the loser up.
INFJ>ENTP.body: People may see you as someone sharp who loves a good argument. But you're also the one checking most carefully that nobody got talked down. Chasing ideas and possibilities stays the same for you in every setting. Quiet thinking and thinking out loud, a warm heart and a logical edge, careful plans and going with the flow—you have a wide range right at hand.
INFJ>ENTP.say: "What if we flipped it? Oh—sorry if that came out harsh."
INFJ>ENTP.do: An idea for a new project comes up mid-chat, you run with it on the spot, and then you rework the plan alone at home.
INFJ>ENTP.worry: Ideas flow when you're with people, but you crash the moment you get home. Every time, the urge to act on a hunch pulls against the urge to make a plan that makes sense.
INFJ>ENTP.karai: You're unbeatable mid-conversation, but the review meeting you hold with yourself on the way home runs way too long.

INFJ>INFJ.title: You've grown your gift for sensing the unseen, straight and true.
INFJ>INFJ.body: Somewhere in your heart, you can always see a picture of how things could be. Your nature and the character you've grown point the same way, so your quiet sense of what's deep in people and your step-by-step pull toward an ideal have grown strong without wobbling. Because you know what matters to you, you shine where it's understood—and wear out, without knowing why, where it isn't.
INFJ>INFJ.say: "You don't have to push yourself. Whenever you want to talk, I'm here."
INFJ>INFJ.do: You can tell from a friend's face that they're down before they say a word, and you quietly leave their favorite snack on their desk.
INFJ>INFJ.worry: You feel other people's emotions so much that you notice your own tiredness late. Your ideals are high, so the gap with reality can leave you feeling low on your own.
INFJ>INFJ.karai: You can read everyone's heart, but you keep missing the sign that you're at your limit.

INFJ>INFP.title: A big goal in your heart, and joy in every detour.
INFJ>INFP.body: You start a year's plan in a beautiful new planner, and three days later it's a diary and a sketchbook. And part of you finds that funny. Recharging alone and treasuring both inspiration and people's feelings has never changed for you. You can move steadily toward a goal and also bend with how you feel that day, and what you find on the detours becomes the seed of your next goal.
INFJ>INFP.say: "I want to do this by next year. If I change my mind along the way, that's fine too."
INFJ>INFP.do: You plan the weekend down to the hour, then rearrange it all on Saturday morning based on your mood—and still feel happy with it.
INFJ>INFP.worry: When you can't stick to a plan, you feel like you've failed. But when the schedule gets tight, you can't breathe, so you keep searching for the right balance.
INFJ>INFP.karai: Making the plan is the most fun part of the plan.

INFJ>ENFJ.title: The host for everyone, then the replay crew of one on the way home.
INFJ>ENFJ.body: At a gathering you keep things bright and organized, and once you're home you replay the day's conversations by yourself. An eye for possibilities, and moving forward with a plan while caring about people, is the part of you that holds steady. You can think deeply alone and also get a room moving, so even figuring out "what next time?" becomes something you enjoy.
INFJ>ENFJ.say: "Thank you all for coming today! Later, tell me one by one how it was."
INFJ>ENFJ.do: After the get-together ends, you send each person a thank-you message that's different from all the others.
INFJ>ENFJ.worry: You love doing things for people, but suddenly you have no time alone at all. It's hard to balance wanting to be counted on with wanting to be left alone.
INFJ>ENFJ.karai: You recharge everyone's heart, but you always leave your own charger at home.

INFJ>ENFP.title: Even with someone new, you catch the feeling behind the words.
INFJ>ENFP.body: You warm up to new people fast, and you still take in the feelings beneath what they say. That's how others see you. Treasuring inspiration and staying close to people's hearts is the steady center that never changes. Quiet depth and a bright spark in a crowd, planning ahead and acting on a whim—you move between them from day to day.
INFJ>ENFP.say: "Wait, that's amazing! Let's do it! …Actually, give me a little time to think first."
INFJ>ENFP.do: You hit it off with someone you just met, trade numbers, and then replay the whole conversation alone once you get home.
INFJ>ENFP.worry: The more fun the day, the harder the tiredness hits at night. Your list of things you want to do keeps growing, and they all matter, yet they all feel half-done.
INFJ>ENFP.karai: You say "I'm in!" to every invite, and on the morning of, you're the one hesitating most.

INFJ>ISTJ.title: Reliable steps, with a quiet touch of care added in.
INFJ>ISTJ.body: When people say "I feel safe leaving this to you," it isn't only because your work is accurate. Thinking calmly on your own and moving forward with a clear outlook is the part your nature and character share, and it doesn't budge. You sense the meaning behind things and check the facts, feel for people and decide with clear reasoning, so gentle care shows through even your most careful steps.
INFJ>ISTJ.say: "These steps are fine as they are. I'll just add a note here for the new folks."
INFJ>ISTJ.do: You finish an exact manual, then handwrite on the last page: "Ask me anytime if you get stuck."
INFJ>ISTJ.worry: You often feel caught between following the rules and honoring the person in front of you. You worry about what's ahead, but without solid grounds you can't move, and your thoughts go in circles.
INFJ>ISTJ.karai: You put people's feelings on the checklist too, so it gets longer every time.

INFJ>ISFJ.title: Big ideals in your heart, small acts of care every single day.
INFJ>ISFJ.body: When a friend moves, you make a schedule and show up with work gloves and drinks for everyone. Recharging alone and moving with a plan while caring about people is the part of you that has always been there. You have both the imagination to picture what lies ahead and the steadiness to trust experience and facts, and together they make your kindness grounded and real.
INFJ>ISFJ.say: "Things are going to get busy, so I'll get ready now. Here—I made you lunch."
INFJ>ISFJ.do: The night you see the weather forecast, you line up umbrellas and spare socks for the whole family by the door.
INFJ>ISFJ.worry: Picturing what might go wrong makes you add more and more to your preparations. Other people's plans come first, and what you want to do keeps getting pushed back.
INFJ>ISFJ.karai: You're already fully prepared for problems that haven't even happened yet.

INFJ>ESTJ.title: You set up the rules, and you think of who's on the other side.
INFJ>ESTJ.body: At the end of your proposal to fix how things run at work, you add: "So everyone can go home on time." Seeing ahead and following through on what you decide is the part of you that wobbles least. Quiet thinking and brisk action, imagination and respect for facts, feeling for people and clear reasoning—you really do manage both sides of each.
INFJ>ESTJ.say: "I need you to keep the deadline. But if you're struggling, tell me early."
INFJ>ESTJ.do: First thing in the morning you make the day's task chart, and you quietly lighten the load for anyone who looks unwell.
INFJ>ESTJ.worry: The more you lead from the front, the less time you have to sort out your thoughts alone. On nights after you've given clear orders, you replay whether you said too much.
INFJ>ESTJ.karai: Your reason for building a system is usually "so nobody ends up crying."

INFJ>ESFJ.title: You make a place for everyone, starting with the seating chart.
INFJ>ESFJ.body: You move around a gathering with a smile, and you've still noticed the one person who's been quiet for a while. Caring about people's feelings and acting with the future in mind is the center your nature and character share. Quietly letting your imagination roam and warming up a room, thinking about meaning and caring for everyday life—you handle both with ease.
INFJ>ESFJ.say: "Tea and snacks are ready! …Hey, you've seemed down for a bit. What's up?"
INFJ>ESFJ.do: After deciding the seating for a birthday party, you picture the flow again and again so the guest of honor never has to feel awkward.
INFJ>ESFJ.worry: You do so much to see people smile that your battery dies the moment you're alone. Protecting the mood sometimes means you miss your chance to say what you wanted.
INFJ>ESFJ.karai: Your day goes like this: filled up by everyone's "thank you," then flopping down alone at home.

INFJ>ISTP.title: Few words, but the fastest hands when someone's in trouble.
INFJ>ISTP.body: When a friend's bike chain slips off, you fix it without a word and then ask, "So how have you been?" Recharging alone and quietly watching how things work is your steady base. Imagination for meaning and hands that check for themselves, care for people and a cool eye for how things work, planning ahead and moving in the moment—all of it lives inside a single action.
INFJ>ISTP.do: When the office printer jams, you're the first to open the back panel and pull the paper out cleanly.
INFJ>ISTP.worry: You show feelings through actions more than words, so your kindness doesn't always come across. You want to think carefully about the future but also focus only on what you can do now, and you can't choose.
INFJ>ISTP.karai: You're fast to show up with a toolbox, but "Are you okay?" never quite makes it out.

INFJ>ISFP.title: Instead of words, you send a seasonal postcard.
INFJ>ISFP.body: Feelings you can't quite put into words, you tuck into a small gift or gesture. That's your way. Valuing quiet time alone and caring about people's feelings above all is what your nature and character share. You see meaning and the road ahead, and you savor colors and textures right in front of you; you can plan, and you can also go softly with your mood.
INFJ>ISFP.say: "These flowers felt like you. …I just want you to feel better."
INFJ>ISFP.do: For a friend who's feeling low, you pick a seasonal postcard and mail it with a short note.
INFJ>ISFP.worry: You know you should think about the future, but you want to honor how you feel right now, so you can't decide. You feel others' pain easily, and one sad news story can weigh on you all day.
INFJ>ISFP.karai: You spend your whole day off choosing a gift to cheer someone up.

INFJ>ESTP.title: Light on your feet and deep in your care—you have both.
INFJ>ESTP.body: You head out on a sudden whim, and on the way back you're the one listening most deeply to your friend's worries. Your nature and character point in different directions on every count, so no single pattern holds you, and your range is wide. Moving fast with the flow and sensing hearts and meaning, the rush to get out there and the quiet time to look back—all of it is yours.
INFJ>ESTP.say: "Let's just go! They've seemed down lately—why don't we invite them?"
INFJ>ESTP.do: Invited to try bouldering for the first time, you say yes on the spot, and during the break you're giving the person next to you career advice.
INFJ>ESTP.worry: When you're on the move it's fun, but once you're alone, a single comment someone made won't leave your head. People tend to see you as light, and how deeply you think rarely comes across.
INFJ>ESTP.karai: You look like you go with the vibe, but you've been thinking about the reason for that vibe for three days.

INFJ>ESFP.title: From the center of the fun, you spot the one on the edge.
INFJ>ESFP.body: The person having the most fun at the party is, on the way home, wondering, "Did she have a good time?" That surprising side is you. Making decisions with people's feelings in mind stays the same in every setting. Thinking deeply alone and livening up a group, imagining meaning and savoring the moment, planning and riding the flow—you move between them freely.
INFJ>ESFP.say: "Today is so much fun! Hey, let's go get her to join us."
INFJ>ESFP.do: After belting out a song at karaoke, you quietly pass the mic and the song list to someone who hasn't sung yet.
INFJ>ESFP.worry: After you've had fun with everything you've got, your heart can't keep up without time alone. Wanting to enjoy now and wanting to prepare for later take turns showing up.
INFJ>ESFP.karai: The second you get home, you switch off along with your phone.

INFP>INTJ.title: You turn the ideal in your heart into timelines and step-by-step plans.
INFP>INTJ.body: You map out your favorite story's world with timelines and maps, until the notes are thicker than the story itself. Thinking deeply alone and picturing what isn't here yet is your unchanging starting point. You stay true to your feelings and reason things through, enjoy the flow and plan ahead, so your ideals don't stay dreams—you break them into steps and make them real.
INFP>INTJ.say: "With this plan, three years should do it. If it stops being fun, we'll rethink it then."
INFP>INTJ.do: You decide to redo your room, collect photos of the mood you love, and then make a chart of every furniture measurement.
INFP>INTJ.worry: The faster things go, the more you stop and ask, "Is my heart actually happy with this?" Even for choices you want to make with your heart, you go looking for a correct reason.
INFP>INTJ.karai: You've made a scored chart of whether things spark joy.

INFP>INTP.title: You can explain "this just makes me cry" with music theory.
INFP>INTP.body: Once you start talking about something you love, you can't stop—and you can explain its charm both as a feeling and as a system. Loving time alone, valuing inspiration, and following your interests is the ground your nature and character share. You care about feelings and you think things through logically, so being moved and analyzing sit at the same table.
INFP>INTP.say: "This song makes me cry somehow. …I think it's because the chord changes right here."
INFP>INTP.do: After a movie, you stay up late writing notes that analyze exactly why it moved you.
INFP>INTP.worry: If you can't explain what you feel with logic, you can't settle down. And sometimes you think so hard that you miss the moment to simply enjoy it.
INFP>INTP.karai: By the time you've figured out why you were moved, the feeling has wandered off.

INFP>ENTJ.title: Hard numbers and "because I love it," in the same slide deck.
INFP>ENTJ.body: In meetings you lay out clear numbers, while the first slide passionately explains why you want to do this at all. Picturing possibilities no one can see yet is the center your nature and character share. Nurturing ideas alone and leading from the front, heart and logic, flexibility and follow-through—you use each one as the goal demands.
INFP>ENTJ.say: "We hit the target this month. Also, I really love this project."
INFP>ENTJ.do: While helping a junior coworker, you sketch out a three-stage action plan on paper and hand it to them right there.
INFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you take the lead, the less time you get to lose yourself in what you love. On days you make tough calls, you wonder whether you went against what you care about.
INFP>ENTJ.karai: In meetings you decide in seconds, but picking dinner takes you thirty minutes.

INFP>ENTP.title: Sharp, joking opinions—with a kind follow-up included.
INFP>ENTP.body: Right after you say "What if we flipped it?", you quietly check the other person's face. Trusting inspiration and moving freely with the situation is something that's always been you. You can dream up ideas alone and grow them by talking, care about feelings and push with logic, so you can enjoy a debate without leaving anyone behind.
INFP>ENTP.say: "Oh—I don't mean your idea's bad, okay?"
INFP>ENTP.do: You invent the rules for a new game while chatting with friends, then secretly work out all the details at home.
INFP>ENTP.worry: When a debate gets fun and you say too much, you spend the whole night uneasy about how they felt. You often feel there's never enough time for either hyping things up with people or daydreaming alone.
INFP>ENTP.karai: Every sharp comeback comes with a quiet little follow-up.

INFP>INFJ.title: You take a passing idea and grow it for a whole year.
INFP>INFJ.body: You picked up a hobby on a whim, and before you knew it, a full year of practice plans filled your planner. Calming your heart alone and treasuring inspiration and people's feelings is the part of you that doesn't move. You can follow your feelings softly and also move steadily ahead, so you can grow a small idea into something that helps others.
INFP>INFJ.say: "This way just feels right somehow. So I'll get it ready by next month."
INFP>INFJ.do: A month before a friend's birthday, you start saving gift ideas on your phone, a little at a time.
INFP>INFJ.worry: Stuck between wanting freedom and wanting things settled, you make plans and erase them. Trying to meet others' expectations, you pack your schedule so full that your own heart gets left behind.
INFP>INFJ.karai: You've even scheduled your "take it easy" days.

INFP>INFP.title: You've always held on to what moves you, simply and sincerely.
INFP>INFP.body: When you find a view you love, you stop, take a photo, and save it with a few words. Your nature and the character you've grown point the same way, so caring for what moves you, staying close to others' pain, and shaping your feelings in your own way have grown without wavering. Where that's welcomed, you shine freely; where it isn't, you lose your spark without knowing why.
INFP>INFP.say: "That's so lovely. …I can't explain it, but it's just good, you know?"
INFP>INFP.do: On the way home after the rain, the sky in a puddle is so pretty that you take the long way back.
INFP>INFP.worry: When you keep doing things that don't fit your heart, it wears down without you knowing why. The harder you try to fit in, the easier it is to lose track of what you loved.
INFP>INFP.karai: The story in your head is past volume ten, but cleaning your room hasn't gotten past page one.

INFP>ENFJ.title: You put your feelings into words and build them with friends.
INFP>ENFJ.body: You plan a small event and gather people, and between tasks you hide in a café to write down what it all means to you. Valuing inspiration and deciding with people's feelings in mind stays the same in every setting. Nurturing your thoughts alone and leading the circle, following your heart and planning ahead—you move back and forth between them.
INFP>ENFJ.say: "If we do it together, it'll be great! I already made the schedule."
INFP>ENFJ.do: The night you hear a friend's sad news, you mail them an encouraging letter with three dates you could meet next.
INFP>ENFJ.worry: As you keep cheering everyone on, your alone time to settle your own feelings disappears. The more you lock in plans to meet expectations, the less free your heart feels.
INFP>ENFJ.karai: You cheer on everyone's dreams at full volume, but your voice gets tiny when it's your dream.

INFP>ENFP.title: You go back and forth between lively days and storybook nights.
INFP>ENFP.body: On the night after you've made everyone laugh, you replay the day's events and savor them like a story. Trusting inspiration, valuing feelings, and moving with the flow is the part of you that stays steady. You can dream deeply on your own and also get energy from people, which is exactly why both kinds of time feel so full.
INFP>ENFP.say: "Let's all go, it'll be so fun! I'm walking home alone, though."
INFP>ENFP.do: The night after a day out with friends, you look back through the photos and make a playlist that fits the memories.
INFP>ENFP.worry: You love seeing people, but after too much you suddenly don't want to talk to anyone. You can't predict that wave yourself, and after turning down an invite you feel guilty.
INFP>ENFP.karai: The number of people you've told "Let's hang out soon!" is way bigger than the free days on your calendar.

INFP>ISTJ.title: A tiny drawing in the corner of a perfect manual.
INFP>ISTJ.body: People often see you as the "very proper" type, yet kindness and a love of beauty slip into the small details of your work. Recharging alone and quietly thinking things over is the ground your nature and character share. Seeing what's not there yet and building on facts, feeling for people and deciding with logic, freedom and follow-through—you can use all of them.
INFP>ISTJ.say: "I'll check and get back to you. Also, could I change the colors on this?"
INFP>ISTJ.do: After writing a flawless instruction manual, you draw a tiny picture in the corner of the last page.
INFP>ISTJ.worry: You're doing everything right, yet sometimes you feel empty: "Is this what I wanted to do?" Even when you start something you love, you look for a reason and a plan first.
INFP>ISTJ.karai: You've even put deadlines on your dreams, and now you're rushing yourself.

INFP>ISFJ.title: A family calendar, with little doodles in the margins.
INFP>ISFJ.body: You remember the likes and plans of the people close to you, and quietly add your own small touch. Calming your heart alone and deciding with people's feelings in mind is the steady piece your nature and character share. Imagination and trust in experience, going where your heart leads and planning ahead—you put all of it into your everyday care.
INFP>ISFJ.say: "Everything's ready for tomorrow. I made you a little good-luck charm, too."
INFP>ISFJ.do: You write the family's plans neatly on the calendar and add small drawings in the blank spaces.
INFP>ISFJ.worry: In days full of things you have to do, time for what you love keeps shrinking. You're happy to help, but sometimes you wonder, "What was it I wanted to do?"
INFP>ISFJ.karai: You never forget anyone's special day, but you push back the deadline on your own dream every year.

INFP>ESTJ.title: You have both the drive to get things done and a gentle heart.
INFP>ESTJ.body: At work you give clear, brisk directions; at home you sink into your favorite music or books alone. Your nature and character point in different directions on every count, so you don't fit a set mold, and your range is wide. The strength to plan and follow through and the sensitivity to settle your heart and protect what matters both come from the same sincerity.
INFP>ESTJ.say: "That's it for today! Is everyone getting enough rest?"
INFP>ESTJ.do: While making the team's schedule, you jot down next to each name something that person has been working hard on lately.
INFP>ESTJ.worry: The more people count on you to lead, the more you push your own feelings aside. After you say something right, you remember the look on their face and feel down.
INFP>ESTJ.karai: In meetings you run things like a drill sergeant; on the way home you're crying at a heartwarming video.

INFP>ESFJ.title: Everyone's comfort, with a spoonful of playfulness.
INFP>ESFJ.body: You set up the welcome party at work smoothly, right down to a handmade card for each new hire. Deciding with people's feelings in mind is what your nature and character both hold dear. Daydreaming alone and warming up a room, inspiration and keeping daily life in order, going with your mood and planning well—you mix them however you like.
INFP>ESFJ.say: "Seats and food are all set! And there's a little surprise, too."
INFP>ESFJ.do: For a friend's housewarming, you pick a plant that suits their room and even give it a name before you hand it over.
INFP>ESFJ.worry: The more you try to meet everyone's expectations, the less time you have to daydream alone. You care so much about harmony that the things you love start to feel selfish.
INFP>ESFJ.karai: After you've collected everyone's "That was fun!", you push your own fun to next month.

INFP>ISTP.title: Quietly working with your hands, putting kindness into what you make.
INFP>ISTP.body: You repair an old piece of furniture yourself, then paint it your favorite color while you're at it, until you love it more than before. Recharging alone and moving freely with the moment stays the same for you. You can picture what doesn't exist yet and test it with your hands, care about feelings and see how things work, so what you make carries your care for whoever uses it.
INFP>ISTP.do: As you measure a homemade shelf, you check again and again that it's at a height the user can reach.
INFP>ISTP.worry: You're not great at putting feelings into words, so your kindness can look curt. Even when you try to settle things with logic, your hands stop if your heart isn't convinced.
INFP>ISTP.karai: All you ever say is "Whatever," yet you remember their favorite color and finish the piece in it.

INFP>ISFP.title: You see a sunset and think of a story's first page.
INFP>ISFP.body: You line up stones and leaves from a trip in a small box and give each one a memory's name. Valuing time alone, putting feelings first, and moving with the flow is what your nature and character share. You can imagine what isn't here yet and savor colors, sounds, and textures exactly as they are, so whatever moves you can become a story or something you make by hand.
INFP>ISFP.say: "Doesn't this sunset look like the start of a story?"
INFP>ISFP.do: You bring home one flower you found on a walk, put it in a tiny jar, and gaze at it for a while.
INFP>ISFP.worry: You love so many things, but you're not sure how to connect them to your future. You don't like clashing with people, so you tend to quietly swallow what you want to say.
INFP>ISFP.karai: You can't throw away a single keepsake, and your drawer has already become a tiny museum.

INFP>ESTP.title: You nudge a hesitant friend forward and jump in together.
INFP>ESTP.body: You give a hesitant friend a push, jump in with them, and still keep an eye on how they feel afterward. Moving flexibly with the situation is the steady center your nature and character share. Dreaming alone and moving with energy among people, inspiration and a grip on reality, caring about feelings and coolly weighing pros and cons—you use each one as the moment calls for.
INFP>ESTP.say: "Don't overthink it, just try! …But if you hate it, tell me right away."
INFP>ESTP.do: Invited fishing for the first time, you say yes instantly, and come home best friends with the person fishing next to you.
INFP>ESTP.worry: After you act on impulse, you're alone wondering, "Did I hurt anyone?" Because people see you as fun and easygoing, it's hard to say you'd like a quiet day.
INFP>ESTP.karai: You'll sign up for bungee jumping in a second, but it takes you five minutes to flag down a server.

INFP>ESFP.title: A master at sharing the fun of right now with everyone.
INFP>ESFP.body: You go around telling everyone about great food and fun places, and in each one you find a story that's just yours. Caring about people's feelings and moving with the flow is your center, no matter what. Getting lost in your imagination and brightening up a group, inspiration and savoring the fun in front of you—you have both.
INFP>ESFP.say: "Everyone's going to love this place! Doesn't it feel like a secret hideout?"
INFP>ESFP.do: On a whim, you start a handmade photo album for a friend's birthday and finish it just in time on the morning of.
